takeaway: Notion's core complaints cluster around speed on large workspaces and unreliable offline mode — both retention risks as power users eye Obsidian. Pricing friction on the AI add-on and a weaker mobile app are secondary but recurring.

issues.title: Large workspaces get slow
issues.gist: Load lag and laggy typing once a workspace passes a few thousand pages.

evidence.quote: painfully slow to load and even typing lags
performance degrades badly with large databases

issues.title: Offline mode is unreliable
issues.gist: Edits lost without a connection; the top reason power users leave for local-first tools.

issues.title: AI add-on feels like nickel-and-diming
issues.gist: Paid users resent a second per-seat charge for AI when rivals bundle it.

issues.title: Mobile app trails desktop
issues.gist: Slow open and clunky database editing make mobile a viewer, not an editor.

evidence.quote: mobile app is slow and clunky

issues.title: Steep learning curve for new users
issues.gist: Databases and relations overwhelm newcomers before they reach the payoff.

evidence.quote: most of my team never got past the blank page

love: Flexibility — one tool for notes, wikis, and databases
Templates and the community ecosystem around them
Clean, calm writing experience for everyday docs

actions.action: Set a per-page load-time budget and ship incremental rendering for large databases
actions.why: Performance is the top complaint from the highest-value cohort and a direct retention/expansion risk vs. faster rivals.

actions.action: Invest in true offline-first sync with visible conflict resolution
actions.why: Offline is the most-requested gap and the most-cited reason for leaving for local-first competitors.

actions.action: Fold a baseline AI allowance into existing paid tiers
actions.why: Bundling converts 'paying twice' resentment into stickiness; meter only heavy usage.

actions.action: Lead onboarding with role-based templates and progressive disclosure
actions.why: Shortening time-to-value is the lever that most moves early activation.
